entries.name: Los Angeles
entries.desc: Home base: office, clients, castings, clubs — this is where the business lives.

entries.name: New York
entries.desc: Press, banks, Broadway: whoever is seen here also exists on the East Coast.

action.name: Press circuit
action.text: Interviews, photographers, dinner with publishers — your name now rings out on the East Coast too.

entries.name: London
entries.desc: Theatre and old money — the school of the quiet tones.

action.name: Theatre night
action.desc: A West End box: instinct +1, sharpens your artistic profile, energy −3.
action.text: Three hours of great stagecraft: instinct +1, your artistic profile sharpens.

entries.name: Cannes
entries.desc: The festival in May: deals on the Croisette that would never happen in L.A.

action.name: Festival dealmaking
action.desc: Croisette talks: influence +2, chance of a favor or an exclusive casting.

lucky.text: On the Croisette a handshake is enough: influence +2 — and someone owes you a favor now.

action.text: Between two screenings a project takes shape: influence +2, a new casting awaits.

entries.name: Venice
entries.desc: The film festival in September: art, prestige and long evenings on the Lido.

action.name: Premiere reception
action.desc: Lido reception: industry standing +3, artistic profile.
action.text: Prosecco with producers on the Lido: industry standing +3, artistic profile sharpened.

entries.name: Las Vegas
entries.desc: Neon and discretion on demand — relax here, or gamble away your reputation.

action.name: All-night bender
action.desc: Stress −10, energy −6 — and sometimes someone sees you anyway.

risk.rumor: Word is {agency} was seen at a roulette table late at night.
risk.text: The night was long — and sadly not discreet: stress −10, public reputation −3.

action.text: Neon, jazz, no clocks: stress −10, energy −6. What happens in Vegas stays there — this time.
